lines: Śrī Śauri named son indeed named Karṇa; who in youth knowing Śāṃbhava principle essence; body abandoning proclaims indeed of people truth; fallen from yoga towards great sage Kṛṣṇa word.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śrīśaurisaṃjñatanayaḥ kila karṇanāmā yo yauvane viditaśāṃbhavatattvasāraḥ dehaṃ tyajan prathayati sma janasya satyaṃ yogacyutaṃ prati mahāmunikṛṣṇavākyam
